restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรมบางใหญ่
text: The dentist was very thorough. They advised me on which teeth had problems and which could be treated later. The molar filling took a while at first, with several adjustments, but once it was finished, it fit perfectly. Before, I had tooth pain every morning, like I was grinding my teeth in my sleep, but that was because a previous filling was too high. After the dentist adjusted it, I feel much more comfortable.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรมบางใหญ่
text: I've never had a tooth extracted before. I was anxious and extremely scared. I didn't know what it would feel like, what was normal, or what wasn't. The assistant explained everything very well. I felt much more relaxed talking to her. Thank you.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรมบางใหญ่
text: The dentist was very kind. They successfully treated a root canal that had been done elsewhere but the tooth had cracked. I highly recommend this clinic.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรมบางใหญ่
text: The doctor was kind, but the assistant was very rough, pulling and pushing my mouth and gums very hard. Their attitude wasn't good either. The counter staff were also unhelpful. I was not impressed.

text:

I had this experience during the COVID-19 pandemic.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรมบางใหญ่
text: Very good. I took my mother (72). My mother had dentures made in the provinces and didn't feel good. Coming here, I thought they wouldn't fix them. I decided to just get new ones (about 6,000). The male doctor (I didn't see the name) told me to be patient and let me see first. He told me what it was like and then slowly fixed it for my mother (it seemed like her teeth were biting too much). In the end, I only paid a hundred baht for the doctor's fee. The doctor was very patient. Thank you very much.
